{"evidence":[{"id":"lc_de9c81939cc8e30e5697f8ac","lines":[1,1],"origin_kind":"original","physical_page":null,"source":"repair-three-grounded-4df48932.md","text":"平均速度 = 路程 ÷ 时间。2 分钟走 120 米，平均速度为 1 米/秒。 分钟换秒要乘 60。60m/min 等于 1m/s；60m/s 则大 60 倍。数量级先统一单位。\n"},{"id":"lc_17626d10bed64bc63534dc88","lines":[3,3],"origin_kind":"original","physical_page":null,"source":"repair-three-grounded-4df48932.md","text":"程序 count=0 遍历列表，只在 value>0 时加 1；0 不满足条件，return 在循环后。 输入 [-2,0,3,5] 的逐次 count 为 0/0/1/2，返回 2；只阅读推理，不执行程序。\n"}],"goal":"能换算平均速度、解释原子性并手推程序条件","goal_version":1,"scope_revision":1,"task":{"answer_text":"1m/s；2分钟=120秒，先统一时间单位，数量级合理。","exercise":{"difficulty":2,"dimensions":[{"description":"给出数值或最终状态","id":"value","point_ids":["p1"]},{"description":"说明单位、性质或条件","id":"unit","point_ids":["p2"]},{"description":"写出换算依据或逐步过程","id":"reason","point_ids":["p3"]},{"description":"说明数量级、资料边界或返回位置","id":"order","point_ids":["p4"]}],"exercise_type":"calculation","reference_explanation":"按给定资料逐项核对，未知原因保留；本样本未运行用户程序。","reference_points":[{"citations":["lc_e6dad89fd29c0649f8808bfd"],"numeric":{"left":"120","operation":"divide","right":"120","tolerance_decimal":null,"unit":"m/s","value_decimal":"1"},"point_id":"p1","text":"统一秒后速度为 1 m/s。"},{"citations":["lc_e6dad89fd29c0649f8808bfd"],"numeric":null,"point_id":"p2","text":"分钟乘 60 才是秒。"},{"citations":["lc_e6dad89fd29c0649f8808bfd"],"numeric":null,"point_id":"p3","text":"直接把分钟当秒会大 60 倍。"},{"citations":["lc_e6dad89fd29c0649f8808bfd"],"numeric":null,"point_id":"p4","text":"明确量纲与数量级检查。"}],"stem":"2 分钟走 120 米，平均速度是多少？说明换算、单位与数量级。"},"kind":"evaluate"}}
